## c8132e595372

**Reproduced defect — advertised controls are behaviorally dead.** Generator SHA-256 `b86a5aa7fcb4347fa99500436796327789b8156178d08d20c2e84758bcd449f5`; canonical rule hash `43a48e2b86e2`. At seed `173`, sample index `5`, the outputs for `palette_kind=warm`, `palette_kind=cool`, `texture=warm`, `texture=cool`, no override, and an unknown `not_an_axis` override are byte-identical (input SHA-256 `958009fce613ba737313318ee3b8e3ca2b23ad8e4a3f47476cbd183c9eb24dee`). The board passes the target `self_check` and belongs to its documented ordinary domain. Thus both advertised palette mechanisms are inert and unknown keys are silently accepted.

Evidence: `checks/audit/c8132e595372/dead_axis.json`. The supported Racket application in `checks/audit/c8132e595372/racket.json` confirms the exact generator/rule hashes, validates the input, and records the authoritative output. No source was changed because this was audit-only.
